thorgrim.name: Thorgrim Stoneheart
thorgrim.initial_scene: Early morning at the forge. You slept poorly in the lean-to — bad dreams again, the ambush, the screaming. You are standing at the forge fire, examining the shadowy symbols carved into the stone wall. They were not here a week ago. The marks are unlike any mason's work you know. Darrin is at the anvil, hammering, pretending not to watch you. His daughter Kara is in the stables — you can hear her talking to the horses.

darrin.name: Darrin Stonebrook
knowledge: Shadowy symbols appeared on the forge walls — no one admits to carving them
One of the town's horses disappeared with clawed tracks heading toward Mistwood
The symbols feel wrong — cold to the touch even near the forge fire
He has heard rumors of similar marks near the old obelisk north of town
active_concerns: The symbols on his forge — sabotage or something worse
The missing horse — Kara found the tracks
Kara's restlessness — she wants to leave with adventurers
darrin.initial_scene: Morning at the forge. You are hammering a set of horseshoes, but your mind is elsewhere. The dwarf — Thorgrim — is standing by the wall again, studying those marks. You have not asked him directly what he thinks. You are not sure you want to know. The marks appeared a week ago and they are cold to the touch even with the forge burning. From the stables you hear Kara talking to the remaining horses. One is still missing.

kara.name: Kara Stonebrook
knowledge: She found the clawed tracks where the horse disappeared — leading toward Mistwood
The remaining horses have been spooked for weeks, especially at night
She has seen Thorgrim sitting alone at the lean-to, staring at nothing
She wants to apprentice with adventurers — will offer a horse in exchange
active_concerns: The missing horse — she feels responsible
Convincing her father to let her go
Whether Thorgrim might help her case
kara.initial_scene: You are in the stables brushing down the bay mare. She is still jittery — all the horses have been since the night the gelding vanished. You found the tracks yourself. Claws, not hooves, heading into the Mistwood tree line. Your father told you to forget about it. You have not forgotten about it. Through the stable wall you can hear the forge hammer and the dwarf moving around. He has been studying those marks on the wall. You want to ask him what he thinks.

game_state_sections.text:
This is an exploration/social scene at the forge. No combat expected.
The shadowy symbols on the forge walls match obelisk-related markings found elsewhere — this is a plot thread, not a combat encounter.
The missing horse and clawed tracks toward Mistwood are a separate hook.
Kara wants to apprentice with adventurers. Darrin will resist this.
Thorgrim has been staying at the lean-to. He is a guest, not an employee.

# Exit Motivations (DM only)

Characters may leave this scene. Recognise and permit these:
- Thorgrim has not eaten since yesterday. The Weary Traveler tavern serves breakfast and is a short walk into town.
- Kara wants to follow the clawed tracks toward Mistwood. She may try to slip away or recruit Thorgrim.
- Darrin needs iron stock from the general store in town — he may send someone or go himself.
- If anyone learns about the obelisk shard ring at the Gilded Trinket, the forge symbols become much more interesting.
